description: Quote, book, and track LTL, FTL, cargo van, and box-truck freight via the Warp API.
name: io.github.warpfreight/warp-agent-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Warp API key (wak_live_* or wak_test_*). Optional — the package prefers ~/.warp/config.json populated by `warp-agent signup` or `warp-agent login`.
environmentVariables.name: WARP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://www.wearewarp.com/api/v1/warp (the warp-site proxy that accepts wak_* tokens). Set to https://gw.wearewarp.com/api/v1 for direct gateway access with a raw customer key.
environmentVariables.name: WARP_API_URL
